trailhead.label: Cable car top stations on the Kronplatz summit (official start)

cautions: No shade at all on the open summit at 2,250 m, with strong sun and wind.
Wide gravel tracks shared with ski-area service vehicles.
Busy round the museums, the peace bell and the giant swing in summer.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Cable car top stations on the Kronplatz: Stazioni a monte degli impianti sulla cima del Kronplatz (partenza ufficiale)
textIt.No shade at all on the open summit at 2,: Nessuna ombra sulla cima aperta a 2.250 m, con sole e vento forti.
textIt.Wide gravel tracks shared with ski-area: Ampie strade sterrate condivise con i mezzi di servizio del comprensorio sciistico.
textIt.Busy round the museums, the peace bell a: D'estate affollato intorno ai musei, alla campana della pace e all'altalena gigante.
